https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The tier holding only digitally-signed competency-assertion and career verbs, access-restricted. A restriction view partitioned by verb set, trust tier and signature.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Authoritative LRS

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A skill, knowledge, ability, trait, or combination required to perform a task or job — the common currency that gives the four TLA data pillars a shared semantics.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Competency

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: Each learner's aggregate competency level, credentials, aptitudes, preferences, goals and career trajectory. The TLA pillar from which the IEEE P2997 Enterprise Learner Record work grew, and the counterpart of that record.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Learner Profile

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A typed metadata descriptor of a learning resource — course, section, activity or content object. The substrate's resource-descriptor primitive specialised for learning resources.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Learning Activity Metadata

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The tier holding every raw xAPI statement, with data ownership retained by the activity owner. A view over the statement set — the unfiltered partition.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Noisy LRS

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The tier holding only the normalised MOM roll-up verbs — the evidence base for competency inference. A restriction view over the statement set, partitioned by verb set.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Transactional LRS

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The smallest launchable unit of content that the LMS tracks: identified by an IRI, with a title, a description and a launch URL, and optionally a launch method, a moveOn criterion, a mastery score, an activity type, launch parameters, an entitlement key and objective references.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Assignable Unit

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A formal, context-neutral representation of one competency — a skill, knowledge, ability, attitude, habit of practice, or learning outcome — with a stable identity, a human-readable description, and optional structured statements.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Competency Definition

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A structured collection of competency definitions and the typed relationships between them — a blueprint of excellent performance.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Competency Framework

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: An attestation of qualification, competence or authority issued by an authority, expressed as a W3C Verifiable Credential whose subject carries one or more claims. Open Badges 3.0 and CLR 2.0 credentials are kinds of it.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Credential

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The aggregate, enterprise-level record of one learner. The P2997 project describes it as a ledger or registry: it holds indications of where subordinate data lives, not the raw data. It therefore emerges as the union of its record entries, scoped to one learner and carrying provenance — not a monolithic class.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Enterprise Learner Record

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: An ordinal level of mastery a learner may attain on a competency — the scale an assertion is measured against.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Proficiency Level

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A <metadata> element: metadata about the package or one of its parts — the schema it follows, its version, and the location of any metadata record kept outside the manifest.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Metadata

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The run-time data of one learner attempt on a SCO, which the SCO reads and writes through API_1484_11: the cmi data model, and ADL's navigation (adl.nav) and shared data (adl.data) data models.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Run-time data

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A recognized interaction the learner responded to, such as a question: its ID, type, objectives, timestamp, correct responses, weighting, learner response, result, latency and description.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Interaction

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A user account on an existing system, such as an LMS or an intranet, identified by the system's home page and the account's name together.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Account

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A unit of instruction, experience or performance that is tracked, identified by an IRI.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Activity

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: Metadata about an Activity: name, description, type, more information, interaction details and extensions.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Activity Definition

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: Whom a Statement is about: an Agent or a Group, and never both.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Actor

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A single person or system, identified by exactly one Inverse Functional Identifier: mbox, mbox_sha1sum, openid or account.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Agent

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A digital artifact logically part of a Statement — an essay, a video, a certificate image, or the JSON Web Signature of a signed Statement — described by its usage type, display name, content type, length and SHA-2 hash.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Attachment

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: Information that gives a Statement more meaning: its registration, context activities, context agents and groups, revision, platform, language, a related Statement and extensions.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Context

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The Activities a Statement is related to, by kind of relation: parent, grouping, category and other.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Context Activities

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A relationship, limited to one Statement, between that Statement and one Agent, characterized by zero or more relevant types.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Context Agent

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A relationship, limited to one Statement, between that Statement and one Group, characterized by zero or more relevant types.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Context Group

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: An extensions map: a node whose properties are extension IRIs, each valued with any JSON value. The meaning and structure of a value are defined by whoever controls its IRI.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Extensions

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A collection of Agents. An Identified Group carries exactly one Inverse Functional Identifier and may list members; an Anonymous Group carries none and must list its members.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Group

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: One element of an interaction component list (a choice, a point on a scale, a source or target to match, or a step), with an id and an optional description.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Interaction Component

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A measured outcome of the experience a Statement records: score, success, completion, response, duration and extensions.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Result

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: An immutable record that an Actor did something: the Actor, the Verb, the Object, and optionally a Result, a Context, a timestamp and Attachments.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Statement

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A pointer to another Statement, by its UUID.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Statement Reference

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: A Statement nested as the Object of another Statement: an actor, verb and object (with optional result, context, timestamp and attachments), but no id, stored, version or authority, and never itself containing a Sub-Statement.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Sub-Statement

https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.definition: The action of a Statement: an IRI that names the meaning (not the word), with a language map giving its display form.
https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com.label: Verb

https://markjspivey-xwisee.github.io/int.definition: A capability that a pod or manifest supports. Used for HATEOAS-style agent discovery of what operations are available.
https://markjspivey-xwisee.github.io/int.label: Affordance

https://schema.org/Course.definition: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative works which aims to build knowledge, competence or ability of learners.
https://schema.org/Course.label: Course

https://schema.org/EducationalOccupation.definition: An educational or occupational credential. A diploma, academic degree, certification, qualification, badge, etc., that may be awarded to a person or other entity that meets the requirements defined by the credentialer.
https://schema.org/EducationalOccupation.label: EducationalOccupationalCredential

https://schema.org/LearningResource.definition:
The LearningResource type can be used to indicate [[CreativeWork]]s (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes.

[[LearningResource]] is expected to be used as an addition to a primary type such as [[Book]], [[VideoObject]], [[Product]] etc.

[[EducationEvent]] serves a similar purpose for event-like things (e.g. a [[Trip]]). A [[LearningResource]] may be created as a result of an [[EducationEvent]], for example by recording one.
https://schema.org/LearningResource.label: LearningResource
